{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 sentinel): {mean_age}")"}
